scope: Requirement inventory only; no gameplay acceptance

cases.variations: Blade, blunt, unarmed, creature; normal/power/directional; skill thresholds; fatigue zero/low/full; difficulty boundaries; reach inside/outside; target behind wall; first/third person.
cases.oracle: Correct rule values, contact causality, one hit/window, no TES3 random miss, correct fatigue/condition/reaction.

cases.variations: Shield, weapon, no legal block; angle boundary; early/late input; light/heavy/mixed/no armor; broken/normal/over-repaired condition; cap boundaries.
cases.oracle: Exact mitigation and wear, correct actor/slot, no negative health/condition or duplicate fatigue charge.

cases.variations: Every audited combat/Sneak/armor ability; below/at/above threshold; valid/invalid posture/equipment; deterministic proc/non-proc; attack direction; disarm/knockdown/paralysis/armor bypass as applicable.
cases.oracle: Real unlocked ability without requiring M16 leveling, correct dropped item/effect duration/mitigation, persistence and no duplicate proc after reload.

cases.variations: Stagger, knockdown, fatigue knockout, essential unconsciousness; attack interrupted; recovery while input held; repeated hits.
cases.oracle: Native durations/eligibility, no stuck controller, no incorrect death/crime, save continuity.

cases.variations: Partial/full draw, cancel, no ammo, moving shooter/target, thin wall, long distance, high speed, simultaneous projectiles, cell change.
cases.oracle: Analytic trajectory bounds, one ammo debit/impact, no tunneling or ghost damage, exact spent/recovered inventory.

cases.variations: NPC/creature/player/essential; melee/arrow/script; simultaneous lethal hits; slopes/stairs; corpse unload; resurrection/reset.
cases.oracle: One death/event/death-item generation, valid physical corpse, correct killer, legal loot and no duplication on reload.

cases.variations: Style variants, aggression/confidence/relationships, ambush, flee/search, ally interference, cover/doors, high/low process, target deletion.
cases.oracle: Real attacks, bounded progress, native-only sequence, correct hostility and schedule resumption.

cases.variations: Mounted input restriction, incoming melee/arrow, horse crime/ownership, rider/horse essential/death, dismount under interruption.
cases.oracle: Vanilla policy, correct damage target, no double crime/hit, reciprocal mount state and safe collision.

cases.variations: Light/dark, LOS/occlusion, near/far, motion/noise, armor/footwear, skills, asleep/unconscious/dead observer, multiple observers.
cases.oracle: Actor-pair awareness agrees with UI/scripts, correct sneak multiplier, no omniscient detection.

cases.variations: Successful/failed/exit/cancel attempt, legal/forbidden item types, one/many items, value/weight boundaries, victim awareness.
cases.oracle: Exact attempt semantics, item conservation/metadata, correct crime intent, no transfer on prohibited/failing action unless native rule says otherwise.

cases.variations: Unowned, reference owner, cell owner, faction/rank, authorized access, owner change, stolen item in mixed stack.
cases.oracle: Single legality answer across actions, exact stolen provenance, no blanket confiscation of legitimate property.

cases.variations: Zero/one/many; victim/bystander/guard; LOS yes/no; responsibility/faction variants; alive/dead/unconscious/disabled; offender known/unknown; observer enters after act.
cases.oracle: Native report decision and timing, exact incident/bounty, duplicate reports do not duplicate one offense.

cases.variations: Trespass warning/escalation/leave; theft/pickpocket/horse taking; assault/murder; lawful enemy/Arena/self-defense; companion/delayed-arrow attribution.
cases.oracle: Distinct actions and legal exceptions, exact fines/flags, persistent unpaid crime, correct victim/owner.

cases.variations: One/many guards, cross-cell pursuit, blocked route, sufficient/exact/insufficient funds, accept/reject yield, pay/jail/resist, cancel, flee/reapproach.
cases.oracle: Correct guard and choices, transactional money/property, no duplicate dialog, unpaid crime not forgotten.

cases.variations: Multiple locations, short/long sentence, no/mixed property, quest items, skill boundaries, serve/cancel/escape, property recovery, re-arrest.
cases.oracle: Correct cell/containers/time/penalty/release, distinct escape state, inventory conservation and idempotency.

cases.variations: Every applicable audited faction/guild discount, immunity or identity-specific bounty path; prerequisites met and unmet.
cases.oracle: Correct gating, persistent identity, no imported Skyrim/Morrowind assumptions. If unavailable in installed content, name the absent dependency and retain synthetic coverage.

cases.variations: Each M15 command/condition/event, aliases, object/player/quest/dialogue contexts, bad targets, callback saves/reentrancy.
cases.oracle: Live-state agreement, exact event attribution/order, no constant/deferred placeholder, typed failure on unsupported use.

cases.variations: M12 controls/stats, M13 stack/equipment/repair/economy, M14 routes/detection/mounts, TES3 combat/crime/jail/inventory/saves.
cases.oracle: Preserved contracts, no native state leakage, no unexplained baseline divergence.
